description: This Java class defines a scheduled task for the OpenMRS medical record system that automatically closes active visits matching certain criteria. It extends AbstractTask and overrides the execute() method to invoke the visit service's stopVisits method.

classes.name: AutoCloseVisitsTask
classes.description: A scheduled task class in OpenMRS that automatically closes unvoided active visits of specific types.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides the execute method to stop active visits using the VisitService, with logging and error handling.
